observations: At indices8..11, fine predominantly vertical fibers dominate; a complete isolated ring is not apparent.
At indices12..15, a region of horizontal fibers and a dark right-side boundary becomes more prominent.
At indices16..23, the upper dark gap expands and the right boundary becomes a broad continuous dark channel; the interior material changes substantially.
interpretation: The model loop is co-located with a real structured transition of material. These views do not distinguish an ink loop from a material-boundary response, and do not prove absent ink or same-sheet anatomy.
